worldcombat.skill.rage.summary: A light angry swing that also lights a furnace of rage: while it burns, every hit the user takes raises its Attack by one step and the fire grows brighter; the fire goes out when the user next acts, keeping the gained Attack. Best used to light up, then trade blows.
worldcombat.skill.rage.use.0: Light the rage first, then wade into the foe
worldcombat.skill.rage.use.1: Stoke Attack step by step as the user is hit
worldcombat.skill.rage.use.2: Roll up a growing Attack in a close brawl
worldcombat.skill.rage.description.0: The angry swing deals about %1$s contact damage; the target's defence, type and crits are applied on the hit. It is light on purpose - the value is the rage that follows.
worldcombat.skill.rage.description.1: It steps up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick with a %3$s block radius, and shoves the target %4$s blocks on a hit.
worldcombat.skill.rage.description.2: The rage lasts %1$s; each real hit taken from outside while it burns (status moves do not count) raises Attack by %2$s step(s) up to %3$s and resets the fire to its full duration; once capped it stops being renewed. The fire goes out when the user next acts, and the Attack it gained stays.
worldcombat.skill.rage.fury.on: Fury form: 2 steps per hit and full after two, but a lower cap, a shorter fire, a slower wind-up and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.rage.fury.off: Banked form: 1 step per hit, a higher cap, a longer fire and a faster wind-up - it grows slowly over time.
worldcombat.skill.rage.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.rage.growth.0: From level %1$s the swing rises to %2$s and the rage lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.rage.growth.1: From level %1$s the swing rises to %2$s, the rage lasts %3$s and the cap rises to %4$s steps.
worldcombat.skill.rage.preference.fury.h: On: 2 Attack steps per hit, but a cap of only 4, a shorter fire, a 2-tick slower wind-up and 4 more cooldown - full after two hits, with a shorter window. Off: 1 step per hit, a cap of 6, a longer fire and a faster wind-up, growing slowly over time.
worldcombat.skill.rage.preference.ai.max: Only light up at a foe within this distance; the step is short, so larger values often still need to close in first.
worldcombat.skill.rage.preference.ai.hea: Only light the rage above this percentage of health - the fire needs hits to grow, so lighting up too low is risky. Lower dares more at low health; higher only strengthens when healthy.
worldcombat.skill.rage.description.addit: The rage is lit before the swing: this blow settles only on the first non-friendly creature in its path and never pierces; even if it misses, the fire catches.
